claim: Azurmendi by Eneko Atxa holds three Michelin stars in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide España, and the tasting menus include a guided tour of the premises with a wicker-basket picnic in front of a vertical garden and appetisers in the kitchen corridor.
quote: Azurmendi is a Three Stars: Exceptional cuisine restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide España... the picnic served in a wicker basket in front of a vertical garden, snacks in a space decorated with recycled organic materials, and maritime-inspired appetisers in the corridor of the kitchen

claim: Azurmendi offers two tasting menus: Adarrak (The Branches) at 315 euros and Gran Menu at 350 euros (VAT included), with optional wine pairings at 150 or 300 euros per person; reservations are via the website Reserve button, phone (+34) 94 455 83 59 or info@azurmendi.restaurant, open Tuesday-Saturday lunch and Friday-Saturday dinner.
quote: "Adarrak" (The Branches): €315 (VAT included); "Gran Menú": €350 (VAT included)... Wine pairings available at €150 or €300 per person... Phone: (+34) 94 455 83 59; Email: info@azurmendi.restaurant... Tuesday-Saturday 1:00-2:30pm; Friday-Saturday also 8:00-9:15pm

claim: Eneko Atxa's group comprises three-Michelin-star Azurmendi and one-Michelin-star ENEKO, both in Larrabetzu (Biscay), plus the more informal ENEKO BASQUE atop the Radisson Collection Hotel on Gran Via in Bilbao.
quote: Azurmendi* — Larrabetzu (Biscay) — 3 stars; ENEKO Larrabetzu — 1 star ("The restaurant has a Michelin star"); ENEKO BASQUE Bilbao — Radisson Collection Hotel (Bilbao)

claim: The casual ENEKO restaurant in Larrabetzu serves the live open-kitchen 'Sutan' menu at 96 euros (VAT included); bookings via eneko.restaurant/en/reserve/, phone (+34) 94 455 88 66 or info@eneko.restaurant, open Wednesday-Sunday lunch plus Friday-Saturday dinner at Barrio Legina s/n.
quote: The restaurant offers one named menu: "Sutan" at €96 (VAT included)... a live cooking open menu... Phone: (+34) 94 455 88 66... Wednesday-Sunday: 1:00pm-3:30pm; Friday-Saturday: Additional service 8:30pm-9:30pm; Location: Barrio Legina s/n, 48195 Larrabetzu

claim: Bodega Gorka Izagirre's 'Hamaiketako' wine-tourism experience costs 30 euros per person at 11:00 daily and includes a tasting of four txakoli wines (Gorka Izagirre, G22, 42 Zura, Ilun) paired with Idiazabal cheese, cured ham and a gilda pintxo, booked online or via (+34) 606 206 651.
quote: the "Hamaiketako experience"... Price: €30 per person; Time: 11:00 AM, Monday through Sunday... Tasting of four wines: Gorka Izagirre, G22, 42 Zura, and Ilun; Local food pairings: Idiazábal cheese, cured ham, and a gilda pintxo

claim: The Gorka Izagirre winery on Barrio Legina was opened in 2005 by the Izagirre family, sits about 15 minutes from Bilbao, and the same complex houses the ample txakoli winemaking facilities, the Azurmendi restaurant and the informal ENEKO bistro on the first floor.
quote: opened in 2005 by the Izagirre family... located in Larrabetzu, just 15 minutes from Bilbao... a family business which includes ample Txakoli winemaking facilities, a state-of-the-art restaurant and an informal bistro... extend the experience with a meal at the ENEKO restaurant (1 Michelin star) in the first floor of the building

claim: Azurmendi is built into a hilltop on the outskirts of Bilbao Airport, surrounded by autochthonous vineyards, in a glass-and-steel bioclimatic building with solar panels, geothermal heating and rainwater harvesting, alongside a 2,500-square-metre txakoli winery.
quote: Azurmendi is located on the outskirt of the Bilbao Airport on a hilltop surrounded by vineyards... a glass and steel building... photovoltaic solar panels and a geothermic system... harvests rainwater... houses a 2,500-square-meter winery producing high-quality txakoli wine

claim: The church of San Emeterio y San Celedonio in Larrabetzu's Goikolexea neighborhood is a Gothic temple, sits on a portico, and houses one of the most important Hispano-Flemish gilded altarpieces in the province.
quote: una de las tallas hispanoflamencas mas importantes de toda la provincia ... iglesia gotica ... la estrella que mas brilla

claim: Larrabetzu was founded in 1376, its historic center was largely rebuilt in neoclassical style after a fire in 1830 and declared a Monumental Ensemble (Conjunto Monumental) in 1994; the Santa Maria de la Asuncion church was designed by Ventura Rodriguez and built 1777-1784.
quote: Fue fundada en 1376 ... un incendio en 1830 destruyo la mayor parte ... reconstruida ... estilo neoclasico ... iglesia de Santa Maria de la Asuncion ... Ventura Rodriguez ... 1777 y 1784

claim: The Goikolexea altarpiece is a small case-work retable in three bodies and three sections, its central figure a late-Gothic expressionist Andra Mari (seated Virgin) with blonde hair, surpassed in Bizkaia only by the one at Santa Maria de Lekeitio.
quote: expresivismo gotico tardio ... la Virgen ... representada en forma de Andra Mari de cabellos rubios ... solo superado por el de Santa Maria de Lequeitio

claim: Larrabetzu sits in the Txorierri valley on the coastal Camino de Santiago, with a neoclassical Monumental-Ensemble old town, the 15th-century Palacio de Ikaza by the town hall and the Palacio Anguleri blending farmhouse and palace; San Isidro festivities fall in mid-May.
quote: hermoso casco historico, declarado Conjunto Monumental ... Palacio de Ikaza ... Palacio Anguleri ... Camino de Santiago ... San Isidro ... mayo

claim: Larrabetzu's village lies in green Txorierri countryside under 10 km from Bilbao, ideal for relaxed walks, with the Palacio Anguleri described as a cubic building of artistic and ethnographic interest.
quote: valle de Txorierri ... ideal para realizar agradables paseos ... a menos de 10 kilometros de Bilbao ... un edificio cubico con un gran interes artistico y etnografico

claim: Larrabetzu's main patron-saint festivities, the Fiestas de Andra Mari y Emetaris, run from mid-August (around Aug 14, Andra Mari/Assumption Aug 15) into early September.
quote: Las fiestas de Andra Mari y Emetaris 2024 de Larrabetzu se celebraran del 14 de agosto al 1 de septiembre

claim: Larrabetzu hosts an annual Txakoli Eguna (Txakoli Day) celebrating the local Bizkaiko Txakolina white wine in the village.
quote: TXAKOLI EGUNA DE LARRABETZU 2025

claim: Larrabetzu's Txakolin Eguna is a morning fair-and-market txakoli festival (roughly 10:00-14:00) held in spring in the village.
quote: La fiesta del Txakoli en Larrabetzu ... Ferias y mercados ... de 10:00 a 14:00

claim: Larrabetzu has a municipal fronton (Basque pelota court) among its sporting facilities.
quote: Fronton - Ayuntamiento de Larrabetzu

claim: A Wikiloc hiking route climbs Bizkargi from Goikolexea (Larrabetzu) on a linear track of about 15.5 km with roughly 533 m of accumulated elevation gain.
quote: Goikolexea (Larrabetzu) Bizkargi

claim: Bizkargi is 555 m and is topped by the Santa Cruz (Santakrutz) hermitage with a stone bell-tower bearing a large stone cross, reachable in about half an hour on a forest path from the Alto de Morga.
quote: se accede por una pista forestal desde el Alto de Morga... la ermita tiene una espadaña de piedra rematada por una gran cruz de piedra

claim: Bizkargi (555 m) is a frequently climbed local peak in Bizkaia, part of a cluster with the adjacent Kurutziagagana (558 m) about 0.5 km away.
quote: Bizkargi (555 m)... Kurutziagagana (558 m)

claim: A shorter Bizkargi loop starts from the Alto de Morga pass between Larrabetzu and Muxika, linking Bizkargi with Arburu in about 8 km.
quote: Alto de Morga-Bizkargi-Arburu Trail

claim: Mount Gorbea (1,482 m), highest peak in Bizkaia, is most easily climbed from Pagomakurre (about 490 m of gain, summit reached in roughly 1h45min) and is crowned by an 18-metre metal cross built in 1907.
quote: 1,482 metres above sea level... 490 metres... 1h 45min... an 18-metre-high metal cross on top

claim: The popular Gorbeia ascent from Pagomakurre is a round trip of about 12.2 km, the easiest and shortest route to the summit.
quote: The route of ascent to the Gorbeia from Pagomakurre has a total of 12.2 km

claim: The Vía Vieja de Lezama greenway is a 7.3 km cyclo-pedestrian path along the disused Bilbao–Lezama railway (closed 1908), including a 500 m tunnel, connecting Bilbao to Derio via Sondika, Zamudio and Loiu.
quote: will run for 7.3 km and will connect Bilbao and Derio, passing through Sondika, Zamudio and Loiu... includes a 500 m long tunnel

claim: Bizkaia's Provincial Council approved a 3.4 km Txorierri bidegorri linking Galdakao (Erletxe) to Larrabetzu, budgeted at around 11.9 million euros with an 18-month build, extending the cycle network toward the village.
quote: bidegorri entre Galdakao y Larrabetzu

claim: Bizkaia is expanding its bidegorri network toward a target of 365 km by 2035, investing about 56 million euros in sustainable mobility in 2025.
quote: Bizkaia pedalea para alcanzar los 365 kilómetros de bidegorris en 2035

claim: An easy Sunday-style walk links Zamudio with Larrabetzu's Goikolexea neighbourhood over almost 12 km through meadows and farmhouses, making it a gentle valley option.
quote: Zamudio-Larrabetzu (Goikolexea), una bonita ruta dominguera

claim: Larrabetzu's Goikolexea neighbourhood holds the Gothic Church of San Emeterio y San Celedonio, with one of Bizkaia's most notable Hispano-Flemish altarpieces, and the village historic centre is a declared Monumental Complex.
quote: Larrabetzu... conjunto monumental

claim: San Juan de Gaztelugatxe requires a free timed ticket, bookable only for the current year via the official Tiketa platform, with an auto-cancel 60 minutes after the scheduled slot and a one-year ban for no-shows.
quote: Reservations can only be made for the current year. ... Reservations auto-cancel 60 minutes after the scheduled time if you don't arrive. ... failing to appear within the designated time prevents new reservations for one year.

claim: Entry to Gaztelugatxe is free but a ticket is mandatory at peak times (every day June 10-Sept 15, weekends April 13-June 9, plus autumn weekends/holidays), with a 1,462 person daily cap and cancellation allowed up to 2 hours before.
quote: Reservations are required every day in the peak summer season ... between June 10 and September 15 ... A limit of 1,462 persons per day has been established. You can cancel your reservation ... up to 2 hours before the date and time of the visit.

claim: The Gernika Peace Museum charges EUR 6.50 general / EUR 4.50 reduced, is free Saturday afternoons and for under-12s, runs Mon 10:00-14:30 and Tue-Sat 10:00-19:00 in high season, and suggests 1h30 for a visit.
quote: General admission: EUR 6.50 ... Free entry: Children under 12, disabled visitors, ICOM members, Saturday afternoons ... Mar 16-Oct 18: Mon 10:00-14:30; Tue-Sat 10:00-19:00; Sun 10:00-14:30 ... allowing 1 h 30 min

claim: Gernika's must-sees cluster around Plaza de los Fueros: the Casa de Juntas (Bizkaia's historic assembly, with the Tree of Gernika), the Peace Museum recreating the 1937 bombing in 3D, and the Euskal Herria museum.
quote: the Casa de Juntas, the Museo Euskal Herria ... the assembly representing Bizkaia province, used to meet, taking decisions under the Tree of Gernika ... the bombing is recreated in a 3D audiovisual and you can hear real testimony by survivors.

claim: Gernika's weekly Monday market is the most important in Bizkaia and recalls the April 26 1937 market-day bombing that destroyed nearly 90% of the town.
quote: Gernika's weekly market is the most important of those held in Bizkaia ... every Monday. ... On April 26th, 1937, which was a market day, Gernika was attacked and nearly 90% of the town was destroyed

claim: Entry to the Casa de Juntas is free, with summer hours 10:00-14:00 and 16:00-19:00 (afternoons close at 18:00 in winter); online booking is recommended at busy times.
quote: Entry to the Casa de Juntas is free but limited ... summer hours are 10:00-14:00 and 16:00-19:00, while winter hours are 10:00-14:00 and 16:00-18:00 (daily).

claim: Mundaka is a fishing village inside the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve famous for a left-hand river-mouth wave rated among the best in Europe, suited mostly to intermediate and advanced surfers.
quote: Mundaka is a tiny fishing village famous for its legendary left-hand river mouth ... some of Europe's best barrels. The waves suit mostly intermediate and advanced surfers ... inside the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve.

claim: Bermeo is a fishing town whose harbour offers fish specialities like marmitako (tuna-potato stew), and beginner surfers head to nearby Laida beach; Gaztelugatxe is the area's tenth-century hermitage islet used as Dragonstone in Game of Thrones.
quote: Bermeo is a quiet seaside town with some amazing food ... like marmitako, a fisherman's stew. ... San Juan de Gaztelugatxe features a tenth-century hermitage dedicated to St. John the Baptist on an islet ... appears in the Game of Thrones series as Dragonstone.

claim: Butron Castle in Gatika is a fairytale fortress rebuilt in 1878 by architect Francisco de Cubas on a Bavarian model, set in the Uribe region near Mungia.
quote: In 1878 the architect Francisco de Cubas, commissioned by the Marquis of Torrecilla, undertook the current reconstruction following the model of the Bavarian castles of the time, transforming Butron into a fairytale castle.

claim: As of 2024-2025 reviews, Butron Castle interior is closed for long-running restoration (scaffolded, work expected to last at least a year), so it can typically only be admired from outside.
quote: the castle is closed for work with nothing specified on the duration of the work, everything is scaffolded so no visit for long ... a reform worker stated they have a lot of time and work, at least a year.

claim: Mungia, in a sheltered valley near the coast and close to Loiu airport, offers the medieval Torrebillela tower-house (now a culture centre), the 16th-century Landetxo Goikoa farmhouse, the Gothic San Pedro church, and a Friday farmers' market (azoka).
quote: Torrebillela towerhouse, of medieval origin ... home to the culture centre. Landetxo Goikoa ... the oldest country house in Bizkaia ... On Fridays the azoka (fair in Basque) is held, where the baserritarras of the area sell ... their best products.

claim: Bilbao to Gaztelugatxe is about a 45-minute drive, with roughly 25-40 minutes between the Gaztelugatxe, Bermeo and Gernika stops; from Larrabetzu (east of Bilbao toward the coast) these times are broadly similar or shorter.
quote: From Bilbao to Gaztelugatxe takes about 45 minutes, then approximately 25-40 minutes between stops ... from Gaztelugatxe area to Bermeo is about 30 minutes, and from Bermeo to Gernika takes another 30 minutes

claim: Guggenheim Bilbao is open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-19:00, closed most Mondays (with listed holiday-Monday exceptions); adult ticket is 15 euros, reduced 7.50, under-18 free, with free entry Tuesdays 18:00-20:00 by advance timed booking.
quote: Adult admission in 2026 is 15 euros; reduced tickets for students (18-26) and retired seniors are 7.50; under-18s enter free. Open Tuesday through Sunday, from 10 am to 7 pm. Free entry every Tuesday from 18:00 to 20:00.

claim: Bilbao's Casco Viejo old town is built around Las Siete Calles, seven parallel medieval streets laid out in the 14th-15th centuries, still pedestrianized and forming the city's prime pintxos zone.
quote: The historic core features a labyrinth of narrow alleys known as Las Siete Calles - the Seven Streets, made up of seven parallel medieval streets laid out in the 14th and 15th centuries, still largely intact and pedestrianized today.

claim: Casco Viejo concentrates over 100 pintxos bars in a compact walkable area, with Plaza Nueva and streets like Barrenkale and Calle Perro the densest; traditional bars are first-come, no reservations.
quote: The Casco Viejo concentrates over 100 bars within a compact walkable area. Plaza Nueva is a neoclassical square framed by arcades filled with pintxo bars. Traditional pintxos bars operate on a first-come, first-served basis with no reservations.

claim: Mercado de la Ribera is one of Europe's largest covered markets, with three floors of fish, produce and food bars; the ground-floor fish market is liveliest before late morning.
quote: The Mercado de la Ribera is one of Europe's largest covered markets, bursting with stalls selling fresh seafood, local cheese, and Basque delicacies. Three floors of fish stalls, produce vendors, meat counters, and food bars.

claim: The Artxanda funicular runs Mon-Sat 07:15-22:00 and Sun/holidays 08:15-22:00 (extended to 23:00 Fri/Sat eves Jun-Sep), departing every 15 minutes for a ~3-minute ride; round trip is 6 euros (5 euro return promo), one-way 3.50.
quote: Monday to Saturday: 7:15 to 22:00 hours. Sundays and Public holidays: 8:15 to 22:00 hours. One-Way Ticket: 3.50 euros. Round Trip Ticket: 6. In barely 3 minutes it reaches Mount Artxanda.

claim: Azkuna Zentroa (former Alhondiga wine warehouse, redesigned by Philippe Starck) is a free-to-enter culture-and-leisure center with Starck's 43 distinctive columns and a rooftop sun terrace with city views; open Mon-Sat, closed Sunday.
quote: Among the features that attract most attention are the forty-three columns designed by Starck. A lift allows you to go to the roof to visit the sun terrace. Monday through Thursday: 7:00 am - 11:00 pm, Saturday: 8:30 am - 11:00 pm, Sunday: Closed.

claim: Bizkaibus line A3223 (via the Artxanda tunnels) links Bilbao and Larrabetzu, running roughly hourly on weekdays/Saturdays from about 05:20 to 22:20 with reduced ~2-hourly holiday service; occasional fare ~1.50 euros, ~0.57 with Creditrans card.
quote: Weekdays & Saturdays: 18 departures from Bilbao starting at 05:20 through 22:20 (hourly). Holidays: 9 departures. Occasional tickets cost 1.50 euros, while Creditrans cards offer a reduced fare of 0.57.

claim: Bizkaibus line A2153 directly connects central Bilbao to Larrabetzu via Loiu (airport), Derio, Zamudio, Parque Tecnologico and Lezama, running roughly hourly from Bilbao 7:00-22:00 and from Larrabetzu 6:30-21:30.
quote: Bus Line A2153 (Bizkaibus) ... connecting the center of Bilbao with the municipalities of Erandio, Lauroeta, Loiu (airport), Derio, Zmudio, Parque Tecnologico, Lezama and Larrabetzu. One bus hourly from Bilbao 7:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m.

claim: Azurmendi sits on a hillside beside an expressway with no practical public-transport door access, so a taxi or self-drive is the realistic way to arrive; a Bilbao-centre taxi runs about 20 minutes and roughly 25-35 euros each way.
quote: The only way to get there (other than self-drive) is to hire a taxi ... about 20 mins and cost around EUR25-30 per trip ... From Plaza Moyua, it's 20 minutes and 35 EUR by taxi. The restaurant ... could help you with that matter.

claim: The Euskotren E3 'Txorierri' line reaches Lezama (the end of the line) from central Bilbao in about 25 minutes but does not extend to Larrabetzu itself, so the last leg from Lezama needs a Bizkaibus or taxi.
quote: The E3 metro line, also known as the Txorierri line, provides service between Bilbao and Lezama ... the metro line does not directly reach Larrabetzu as a metro service. Instead, there is a Bizkaibus option on the Bilbao-Larrabetzu route.

claim: Larrabetzu and neighbouring Lezama sit ~2.5 km apart (about a 33-minute walk); the Madarian farmhouse near Lezama is 400 m from the Euskotren station, which reaches central Bilbao in 25 minutes, illustrating the area's caserio/agroturismo lodging served by the Txorierri line.
quote: Euskotren's station is situated at 400 m from the Madarian rural accommodation ... it communicates with the heart of Bilbao in 25 minutes. Lezama is 2,526 meters away from Larrabetzu (about a 33-minute walk).

claim: Larrabetzu's lodging is thin: Agroturismo Miamendi is ranked the #1 (of only 1) B&B/inn in the village, an air-conditioned rural property with garden and mountain views, free WiFi and an on-site restaurant.
quote: Casa Rural Miamendi in Larrabetzu offers air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms, garden and mountain views ... ranked #1 of 1 B&B/inn in Spain/Larrabetzu on Tripadvisor. The property offers an on-site restaurant.

claim: Nearby Mungia offers Agroturismo Araize, a 6-room farmhouse a 15-minute drive from Bilbao airport with free private parking, from roughly 62-82 euros a night, typical of the Bizkaia agroturismo options around Larrabetzu.
quote: Agroturismo Araize Guest House is a 6-room property 15 minutes' drive from Bilbao airport and located a 10-minute ride from Monte Jata, providing Wi-Fi and free private parking. Rates start from $82.

claim: Bilbao has a mild oceanic climate with rain spread evenly year-round and only ~1,600 sunshine hours; the best window is June to mid-September (warmest, driest), with May and September good shoulder months, while November and April are rainiest.
quote: The best time to visit Bilbao is from June to mid-September, since it is the warmest and driest period ... November and April are usually the rainiest months ... just 1,600 hours of sunshine per year ... summer ... range between 13 C and 26 C.
